column1: # Relocated data the game reads past its symbol's own size (GS11, trap 36). The reference build places unnamed
# section pieces right after the symbol; the game copies them together (System_InstallIwramAndIrqs copies 14
# handlers from gDefaultIrqHandlers, whose symbol covers 10). bind.py widens the buffer to `size` and moves the
# piece's relocs.tsv slots into it at `offset`. Checked: the pieces lie at symbol + offset in the reference map.
